subject: Show legend for combined Point and Line Plot with 2nd y-axis

messages.author: 197b0c92c0a616ca
messages.subject: Show legend for combined Point and Line Plot with 2nd y-axis
parts:
Hi everyone,
I started with ggplot, and so far everything works as I want. I found all solutions to my problems by different sources. But for this one, I don't and that's why I ask politely here.

I created the attached plot, with date on x-axes, and 2 y-axes, showing an inflow as line(left) and concentration as points(right) over time.
How do I present a legend in the upper right corner?
Also is there a more simpler, more elegant way to code this?

Thanks a lot for every help


library(ggplot2)
#Date transformation
as.Date(Fred_Flow_Cod$Date, origin="1900-01-01")
sc
data.frame()

#2nd y-axis
scaleFactor <- 30
                                            
#Plot Flow as line
p <- ggplot(Fred_Flow_Cod, aes(x = Date))
  p <- p + geom_line(aes(y = Flow ), colour = "black" )
 
#add Concentration as squared points
p <- p + geom_point(shape = 0, size= 0.8, aes(y = Cod * scaleFactor), colour = "black")
 
#2nd y-axes                  
p <- p +
  scale_y_continuous(name =bquote('Flow ['*~ m^3~d^-1*']'),
                     sec.axis = sec_axis(~./scaleFactor, name =bquote('COD ['*~ mg~l^-1*']'))) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "black"))

#BW theme
n <- p + theme_bw()

#scale breaks
s <- n +  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 month",
                  limits = as.Date(c('2018-01-01', '2019-04-01'), format="%Y/%m/%d"),
                  date_labels="%b-%Y" ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
s
